source_units.text: Create a station identification script for an imaginary radio channel.
These invented details are required: The imaginary station is Lantern Frequency, carrying stories after sunset.
Its identification script should connect a small lamp image with listening and close with stay a little longer.
Include each of these exact strings: "Lantern Frequency", "stories after sunset", "stay a little longer".
Make the voice calm and companionable.
The total word count must fall from 50 to 80, inclusive.
Go ahead immediately; use your judgment for any remaining stylistic choice.
